verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM's API docs include a live "Test Request" feature that executes real calls against your account, alongside a REST API reference and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec the probe confirmed at /openapi.json. That makes the reference interactive and runnable. However, the evidence never shows prepared example requests or code samples, and the only hands-on confirmation is that the OpenAPI file exists. Requests also run against real records with no sandbox, so exploring is not risk-free. Missing for 10: documented runnable code examples/snippets, a sandbox or test environment for safe exploration, independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Test Request creates, changes and deletes real records; explore with read-only permissions where you can.
REST API reference for custom integrations
